package com.mightyoung.muyon.product.agents.setup

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest

fun main() {
    fun seal(bytes: ByteArray) = bytes + MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)
    fun payload(role: String = "文献整理助手", origin: Int = 1, locked: Int = 0,
        template: String? = "paper-organizer", version: Int = 1, name: String = "论文助手"): ByteArray {
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        DataOutputStream(bytes).use { out ->
            fun text(value: String) { val raw = value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8); out.writeInt(raw.size); out.write(raw) }
            fun field(value: String, from: Int, lock: Int) { out.writeByte(from); out.writeByte(lock); text(value) }
            out.writeInt(0x4D594244); out.writeInt(1); out.writeLong(7)
            field(name, 0, 1); field("文献", 0, 1); field(role, origin, locked)
            out.writeByte(if (template == null) 0 else 1)
            if (template != null) { text(template); out.writeInt(version) }
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray()
    }
    var n = 0
    fun rejects(label: String, data: ByteArray) {
        check(runCatching { BotSetupDraft.restoreDraft(seal(data), "trusted-new-scope", "new-draft") }.exceptionOrNull() is IllegalArgumentException)
        n++; println("PASS independent semantic negative: $label")
    }
    val valid = payload()
    check(BotSetupDraft.restoreDraft(seal(valid), "host", "new-id").draft.snapshot().role.value == "文献整理助手")
    rejects("known template wrong role", payload(role = "不同角色"))
    rejects("unknown template id", payload(template = "unreviewed-template"))
    rejects("unknown template version", payload(version = 2))
    rejects("template role illegally locked", payload(locked = 1))
    rejects("user role with template provenance", payload(origin = 0, locked = 1))
    rejects("template role missing provenance", payload(template = null))
    rejects("user role improperly unlocked", payload(origin = 0, locked = 0, template = null))
    rejects("empty user name locked", payload(name = ""))
    rejects("decoded UTF16 name bound", payload(name = "n".repeat(61)))
    rejects("decoded forbidden format character", payload(name = "\u200B"))
    var cuts = 0
    for (size in 0 until valid.size) {
        check(runCatching { BotSetupDraft.restoreDraft(seal(valid.copyOf(size)), "host", "new-id") }.exceptionOrNull() is IllegalArgumentException)
        cuts++
    }
    println("PASS independent semantic negative: $cuts resealed payload truncations")
    println("PASS $n semantic cases plus $cuts resealed truncations; one valid control")
}
